# Sales performance dashboard

*Client industry: wholesale | Completed: 2022-06-01 | Evidence id: data_analyst:case:p00*

## The problem
The client was a distributor reviewing sales in 20 emailed spreadsheets.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Power BI, hand-written analytical queries, spreadsheet models with pivot tables. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project replaced 20 weekly spreadsheets with one dashboard.
